reviewItem.question: Does "We have changed the default value of `Certificate.Spec.RevisionHistoryLimit` from `nil` to `1`. > 📖 Read Release 1.18 notes for more information." mean a change to crd-field:cert-manager|group=cert-manager.io|kind=Certificate|path=spec.revisionHistoryLimit (default-changed)?

proposed.statement: The default of Certificate spec.revisionHistoryLimit changed from nil to 1, so stale CertificateRequests are garbage collected on upgrade unless the field is set explicitly.
